# R7B isolated execution fixture

Run `node --experimental-strip-types tests/fixtures/teaching-agent-r7b/start.mjs` from the repository root. It binds only to 127.0.0.1 and mounts the existing LessonRuntime. No production account, database or Provider is used.

`video.webm` is a 30-second synthetic development test pattern, generated by `create-video.mjs`. It is outside public assets and production publishing inputs. It is not teaching media or verified audio.

The server uses the existing single_choice grader. All attempts, pending cues and completion evidence are isolated in-process fixtures. Refresh tests retain this server process; server restart loses fixture state. Production durable progress is NOT VERIFIED. Source content is read server-side from the locked R6F evidence. Only Node5 text and the first public question are projected. Node7's complete authoring text and private grading key never enter the browser bundle.

A completed activity never means a completed Step or Lesson. Atomic RPC is NOT USED. The canonical production binding is deferred to R7C.
